author: Larry Yehle
text: Another great job by TCR Plumbing for us.   Joe Grena was on time (actually a little early!), professional and did an excellent job repairing multiple issues....faucets, toilets, etc.  Excellent communication and fair pricing.  Highly recommend!

author: Meaningful Minds Counseling
text: Incredible family owned company. It’s hard finding good knowledgeable and honest plumbing companies but look no further. This company is the best of the best and the family that owns it goes above and beyond for their customers. You won’t regret using them for your plumbing needs!

author: Dave Malta
text: Terry had his repipe team at our house at 7:30 AM and they completed the PB repipe job including testing and a meticulous cleanup by 4 PM.  Our house size is 2300 SF / 2.5 baths.  The team was highly skilled and experienced, and they were complete gentlemen.  They were cleaver and strategic in minimizing sheet rock intrusion.  Only small openings were created mostly in the ceiling to access key pipe locations.  (A few photo examples included)  A small access door was created inside the bathroom vanity cabinet to access the garden tub plumbing. Much of the pipe replacement was done without any sheetrock demo.  We would highly recommend the TCR Rooter team for a repipe job.  Thanks Matt, Devin, Pedro, and Joe for an excellent job.

author: Naydasia Ruiz
text: I never leave reviews, but today I will! I just wanted to express how meticulous and sweet Brett was today during my repair! He was super communicative and went the extra mile to ensure our companies clogging doesn't happen again! He even went above and beyond into checking in with his boss about getting a camera to take a further look! We will be using him for our all of our services going forward! Thank you again Brett, you're AMAZING!!

author: Marie Simpson
text: TCR is my absolute go to for any plumbing and sewer issues in the HOA Communities that I manage. They respond quickly and have provided the best service for me for the last 10 years!
